Document the `unavailable` state so agents do not treat a metric with unaccrued signal as zero.

Add a hand-written Metrics section to docs/user-guide.md describing the command, the four lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and the unavailable state.
Reference the reusable rebar.metrics subsystem (MetricSpec/REGISTRY registry and is_authoritative segregation) in docs/reuse-surface.md.
Add a single Metrics pointer line to the AGENTS.md 'Where to read' list pointing at the user-guide and reuse-surface docs.
This is docs/skill-only with no src/rebar change; additive and reversible, and docs-index/README drift gates must still pass.
